scenario: 一个 300M 参数的 ViT 要跑在手机上,预算 <50MB 内存、<10ms 延迟,准确率还不能崩。
scenario_en: A 300M-param ViT must run on a phone under 50MB memory / 10ms latency without wrecking accuracy.
q: 把模型压到部署预算内,该按什么顺序试压缩手段?
q_en: To fit the deployment budget, in what order should you try compression techniques?
why: 按成本从低到高依次试:量化→剪枝→蒸馏→NAS,达到预算就停。先试最便宜的量化,不够再叠更贵的手段。这样用最小代价满足 <50MB/<10ms,而不是一上来就烧 NAS 的上千 GPU 小时。
why_en: Apply cheapest-to-most-expensive — quantization, pruning, distillation, NAS — stopping once the budget is met, rather than jumping to the costliest first.
diagram:
flowchart LR Q["量化
最便宜"] --> P["剪枝"] P --> D["蒸馏"] D --> N["NAS
最贵"]
options: 先上最贵的 NAS 从头搜一个新架构,图省事一步到位
按成本从低到高:量化→剪枝→蒸馏→NAS,达到预算就停
只申请加大手机内存配额来装下原模型,完全不压缩
随便挑一个手段(比如先上蒸馏)压到底,不排成本顺序
options_en: Start with the costliest NAS to search a new architecture from scratch, hoping to get there in one shot.
Go cheapest to most expensive: quantization, pruning, distillation, NAS, stopping once the budget is met.
Just request a bigger phone memory quota to fit the original model without compressing at all.
Pick any one technique at random (say, distillation first) and push it all the way, ignoring cost order.
whenOtherWins: 若便宜手段(量化/剪枝/蒸馏)都达不到预算,或本就要为该硬件长期投入,才值得上 NAS 从头搜架构。
optionExplanations: NAS 最贵(上千 GPU 小时),一上来就用是杀鸡用牛刀,多数预算靠更便宜手段就能满足。
对;成本递增地试、达标即停,是用最小代价满足部署约束的成熟做法。
改硬件不是模型压缩,手机内存/延迟预算通常是硬约束,改不了。
不按成本顺序可能既费力又过度,合理做法是先便宜后昂贵、够了就停。
optionExplanations_en: NAS is costliest (thousands of GPU-hours); leading with it is overkill when cheaper techniques usually meet the budget.
Correct — escalating cost and stopping when met is the mature way to satisfy deployment constraints at minimal cost.
Changing hardware isn't model compression, and phone memory/latency budgets are usually hard constraints.
Ignoring cost order risks both effort and over-engineering; the sound approach is cheap-first and stop when enough.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在尽量保住准确率的前提下缩小模型体积/延迟,以适配部署约束。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Model compression shrinks a model's size/latency while preserving accuracy, to meet deployment constraints.

termDefinitions.meaning: 自动搜索高效网络结构的方法,效果好但历史上算力开销极大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NAS (Neural Architecture Search) automatically searches efficient architectures, effective but historically very compute-heavy.

scenario: 面试官问决定"微调预训练模型还是从头训"要看哪两个维度。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks which two dimensions decide 'fine-tune a pretrained model vs train from scratch'.
q: 迁移学习的决策该沿哪两个轴判断?
q_en: Along which two axes should you make the transfer-learning decision?
why: 两个轴:任务与源任务的相似度、目标域有标注数据量。相似度高→可复用预训练特征;数据量大→敢多解冻/从头训。四象限各对应不同策略,别一律"直接微调预训练模型",要说清自己落在哪个象限。
why_en: Decide on task similarity to the source and target labeled-data volume; the four quadrants map to different strategies.
options: 只看模型参数量:参数越大就越该全量微调
任务相似度 + 目标域标注数据量,两轴四象限
只看 GPU 预算:算力够就全量微调,不够只训 head
看模型发表年份和作者名气,挑最新最有名的骨干
options_en: Only parameter count: the bigger the model, the more it should be fully fine-tuned.
Task similarity plus target labeled-data volume — two axes, four quadrants.
Only GPU budget: full fine-tune if compute allows, otherwise train just the head.
Publication year and author fame — pick the newest, most famous backbone.
optionExplanations: 参数量不决定该微调还是从头训,相似度和数据量才是判据。
对;相似度决定能否复用特征、数据量决定能解冻多少/敢不敢从头训,两轴四象限。
GPU 预算是约束不是决定迁移策略的核心两轴。
年份和名气与迁移决策无关,是无信息维度。
optionExplanations_en: Parameter count doesn't decide fine-tune vs from-scratch; similarity and data volume are the criteria.
Correct — similarity governs feature reuse and data volume governs how much to unfreeze or whether to train fresh, giving four quadrants.
GPU budget is a constraint, not the core two axes of transfer strategy.
Year and fame are irrelevant to the transfer decision, uninformative dimensions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 拿在大数据上预训练的模型作起点,在目标任务上微调,省数据省算力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Transfer learning starts from a model pretrained on large data and fine-tunes it on the target task.

termDefinitions.meaning: 目标任务与预训练源任务在数据分布/特征上的接近程度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Task similarity is how close the target task is to the pretraining source task in data distribution and features.

scenario: 医学影像分类,骨干用 ImageNet 预训练(任务相似),但只有几千张有标注医学图。
scenario_en: Medical-image classification on an ImageNet-pretrained backbone (similar task) with only a few thousand labeled images.
q: 高相似度+小数据该怎么微调?
q_en: High similarity plus small data — how do you fine-tune?
why: 冻结骨干、只微调 head:任务相似说明预训练特征可直接复用,数据少则解冻太多层会过拟合。只训 head 让可训练参数最少,用几千张也能稳。首要风险就是解冻层数过多导致过拟合。
why_en: Freeze the base and fine-tune only the head: similar tasks reuse pretrained features, and with little data unfreezing too many layers overfits.
options: 全量微调所有层,数据少也要让模型充分适应
冻结骨干,只微调 head(可训练参数最少)
从头训一个新模型,不复用 ImageNet 预训练权重
解冻一半层并随机初始化再训,兼顾复用与适应
options_en: Full fine-tune every layer; even with little data, let the model fully adapt.
Freeze the backbone and fine-tune only the head, keeping trainable params minimal.
Train a new model from scratch, not reusing the ImageNet pretrained weights.
Unfreeze half the layers, re-initialize them randomly, and train — reuse plus adaptation.
whenOtherWins: 当同样高相似但目标数据量很大时,可全量微调并配 layer-wise LR decay,以更充分适应目标域。
optionExplanations: 小数据全量微调会过拟合,解冻越多可训练参数越多,几千张撑不住。
对;冻骨干+训 head 把可训练参数压到最小,复用特征又不过拟合,是该象限标准解。
任务相似时从头训浪费了可复用的预训练特征,小数据更训不好。
随机初始化解冻层丢掉了预训练权重,等于半从头训,小数据下更容易崩。
optionExplanations_en: Full fine-tuning on small data overfits; more unfrozen layers means more trainable params that a few thousand images can't support.
Correct — freeze base plus train head minimizes trainable params, reusing features without overfitting, the standard quadrant solution.
From scratch on a similar task wastes reusable pretrained features and trains worse on small data.
Randomly re-initializing unfrozen layers discards pretrained weights, effectively half-from-scratch, more likely to collapse on small data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把某些层的权重固定不参与训练,只训未冻结部分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Freezing fixes certain layers' weights so only the unfrozen parts train.

termDefinitions.meaning: 接在骨干之上的任务专属输出层,微调时常只训它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The head is the task-specific output layer atop the backbone, often the only part fine-tuned.

tradeoff: 复用预训练特征 vs 解冻层数带来的过拟合风险

scenario: 把 BERT 微调到搜索排序,任务相似度高,而且有大量标注数据。
scenario_en: Fine-tuning BERT for search ranking, a similar task, with a large amount of labeled data.
q: 高相似度+大数据该怎么训?
q_en: High similarity plus large data — how do you train?
why: 全量微调 + layer-wise 学习率衰减(浅层小 lr、深层大 lr):数据多足以调动全部参数,分层 lr 让接近输入的通用层小步微调、接近输出的任务层大步适应。主要风险是 lr 太大导致灾难性遗忘。
why_en: Full fine-tune with layer-wise LR decay (small LR for early layers, higher for late), since large data supports tuning all params while decay guards against catastrophic forgetting.
options: 只冻结骨干训 head,大数据下也不必动骨干
全量微调,配 layer-wise LR decay
从头随机初始化训练,丢掉 BERT 已学到的预训练权重
只训练最后一层的偏置项,其余参数全部冻结
options_en: Freeze the backbone and train only the head; even with big data, leave the base alone.
Full fine-tune with layer-wise LR decay.
Train from scratch with random init, discarding BERT's already-learned pretrained weights.
Train only the last layer bias terms and freeze everything else.
whenOtherWins: 若同样高相似但数据很少,应退回"冻骨干只训 head",因为全量微调在小数据上会过拟合。
optionExplanations: 数据充足时只训 head 没充分利用数据,骨干也能安全适应目标域,收益被浪费。
对;大数据支撑全量微调,layer-wise LR decay 兼顾通用层稳定与任务层适应,防遗忘。
任务相似时从头训浪费预训练,收敛更慢、效果通常更差。
只训偏置项可训练容量太小,大数据高相似场景发挥不出来。
optionExplanations_en: With ample data, head-only underuses it; the base can safely adapt too, so the gain is wasted.
Correct — large data supports full fine-tuning, and layer-wise LR decay balances stable general layers with adapting task layers, guarding against forgetting.
From scratch on a similar task wastes pretraining, converging slower and usually worse.
Training only biases has too little capacity to exploit large-data high-similarity settings.

termDefinitions.term: layer-wise LR decay / 分层学习率衰减
termDefinitions.meaning: 越靠近输入的层用越小学习率,越靠近输出的层用越大,防通用层被大步改坏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Layer-wise LR decay uses smaller learning rates for earlier layers and larger for later ones, protecting general layers.

termDefinitions.meaning: 微调时学习率过大,模型迅速覆盖掉预训练学到的通用知识。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Catastrophic forgetting is when a too-high fine-tuning LR quickly overwrites the general knowledge learned in pretraining.

tradeoff: 全参数适应能力 vs 灾难性遗忘的风险

scenario: 用 NLP 骨干去做卫星影像任务(任务极不相似),而且只有很少标注数据——最危险的象限。
scenario_en: Using an NLP backbone for satellite imagery (very dissimilar) with little labeled data — the most dangerous quadrant.
q: 低相似度+小数据该怎么办?
q_en: Low similarity plus small data — what do you do?
why: 这是最危险的象限:直接全量微调不相关骨干会负迁移+遗忘。走 PEFT(少量新增参数试探性适配)或干脆从头训小模型;别硬套不相关的预训练权重。数据太少还要防过拟合。
why_en: This most dangerous quadrant risks negative transfer, so use PEFT or train a small model from scratch rather than forcing an unrelated backbone.
options: 全量微调这个不相关骨干,让它彻底适应新任务
走 PEFT 或从头训小模型,别硬套不相关骨干
冻结骨干只训 head,复用不相关特征也无妨
直接拿骨干做零样本推理,一个参数都不训练
options_en: Full fine-tune this unrelated backbone so it fully adapts to the new task.
Use PEFT or train a small model from scratch; do not force an unrelated backbone.
Freeze the backbone and train only the head; reusing unrelated features is fine.
Just run the backbone zero-shot and train nothing at all.
whenOtherWins: 若同样低相似但数据量很大,直接从头训练更稳妥,数据足以支撑不依赖任何迁移。
optionExplanations: 全量微调不相关骨干易负迁移,小数据还会过拟合,是这象限最典型的坑。
对;PEFT 试探性适配或从头训小模型,避开硬套不相关权重的负迁移,是该象限稳妥解。
骨干特征与卫星影像不相关,复用它等于给 head 灌无用甚至误导的特征。
任务极不相似,零样本推理几乎没有可迁移信号,不训练无从适配。
optionExplanations_en: Full fine-tuning an unrelated backbone invites negative transfer and small-data overfitting, the classic trap of this quadrant.
Correct — PEFT for tentative adaptation or a small from-scratch model avoids forcing unrelated weights, the safe quadrant solution.
The backbone's features are unrelated to satellite imagery, so reusing them feeds the head useless or misleading features.
With very low similarity, zero-shot has almost no transferable signal, and no training means no adaptation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 冻结大部分权重,只更新少量新增参数的微调范式,如 LoRA。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PEFT (Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning) freezes most weights and updates only a small added set, e.g. LoRA.

termDefinitions.meaning: 源任务与目标不相关时,迁移不但没帮助反而损害目标任务性能。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Negative transfer is when an unrelated source task hurts rather than helps the target task.

tradeoff: 迁移省数据 vs 负迁移与小数据过拟合

scenario: 在专有特征上做欺诈模型,和任何公开预训练任务都不相似,但自有标注数据量很大。
scenario_en: A fraud model on proprietary features, dissimilar to any public pretraining, but with a large in-house labeled dataset.
q: 低相似度+大数据该怎么选?
q_en: Low similarity plus large data — which strategy?
why: 从头训练(或仅用预训练权重做初始化):数据量足以支撑从零学到专有特征的表示,而任务不相似意味着迁移可能是负的、白搭。主要风险是若强行迁移不相关模型只会浪费算力。
why_en: Train from scratch (or use pretrained weights only as init): ample data supports learning proprietary features, while dissimilarity makes transfer likely negative.
options: 冻结公开预训练骨干只训 head,省事又省算力
从头训练,或只把预训练权重当初始化
只做零样本推理,一个参数都不训练
用 LoRA 在不相关骨干上加适配器就够了
options_en: Freeze the public pretrained backbone and train only the head — easy and compute-cheap.
Train from scratch, or use pretrained weights merely as initialization.
Do zero-shot inference only and train no parameters at all.
Just add LoRA adapters on top of the unrelated backbone.
whenOtherWins: 若任务其实与某个预训练源相似,即使数据多也该优先全量微调复用特征,而非从头训。
optionExplanations: 不相关骨干的特征对专有欺诈特征没用,冻它训 head 等于用错的特征底座。
对;数据足以从头学专有表示,不相似让迁移收益存疑,从头训避免负迁移浪费。
零样本对专有特征没有可迁移信号,不训练无法建模。
LoRA 仍依赖骨干原有表示,骨干不相关时适配器也补不回缺失的相关特征。
optionExplanations_en: An unrelated backbone's features are useless for proprietary fraud features, so freezing it and training the head uses the wrong base.
Correct — ample data supports learning proprietary representations, and dissimilarity makes transfer dubious, so from-scratch avoids wasted negative transfer.
Zero-shot has no transferable signal for proprietary features, and no training means no modeling.
LoRA still relies on the backbone's representations, which an unrelated backbone lacks, so adapters can't recover the missing relevant features.
tradeoff: 迁移省算力 vs 任务不相似带来的负迁移

scenario: 面试官要你用一张四象限表说清迁移策略,别一律"直接微调"。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to lay out the four-quadrant transfer strategy instead of defaulting to 'just fine-tune'.
q: 任务相似度×数据量的四象限分别对应什么策略?
q_en: What strategy does each quadrant of similarity x data volume map to?
why: 高相似小数据→冻骨干只训 head;高相似大数据→全量微调+分层 lr;低相似小数据→PEFT/从头训(最危险);低相似大数据→从头训。相似度决定复用多少,数据量决定能改多少,别默认"直接微调预训练模型"。
why_en: High-sim small-data freezes to head-only, high-sim big-data full fine-tunes with LR decay, low-sim small-data uses PEFT/from-scratch, low-sim big-data trains from scratch.
options: 不分象限,一律"直接微调预训练模型"就够用了
四象限各配一策:冻 head / 全量 / PEFT / 从头
数据越多就越该冻结骨干、数据越少就越该全量微调,和实际相反
四象限用的策略其实完全一样,只是叫法不同罢了
options_en: No quadrants needed — always just fine-tune the pretrained model.
Each quadrant gets its own strategy: freeze head, full fine-tune, PEFT, or from scratch.
More data means more freezing and less data means full fine-tuning — reversed from reality.
All four quadrants really use the same strategy under different names.
optionExplanations: 一律直接微调忽略象限差异,低相似时会负迁移、小数据时会过拟合。
对;四象限各有其解,相似度定复用、数据量定改动幅度,这才是成熟答法。
关系说反了:数据多才敢全量微调,数据少才要冻结防过拟合。
四象限策略实质不同,冻结/全量/PEFT/从头各异,不是名字差异。
optionExplanations_en: Uniformly fine-tuning ignores quadrant differences, risking negative transfer at low similarity and overfitting on small data.
Correct — each quadrant has its solution, with similarity setting reuse and data setting change magnitude, the mature answer.
The relationship is reversed: more data enables full fine-tuning, less data needs freezing to avoid overfitting.
The quadrant strategies differ substantively (freeze/full/PEFT/scratch), not just in name.
tradeoff: 复用预训练特征的多少 vs 目标数据量允许改动的幅度

scenario: 全量微调 BERT 时学习率设得偏大,发现模型在新任务上过一会儿反而通用能力全丢了。
scenario_en: Full fine-tuning BERT with a high learning rate, the model soon loses its general ability on the new task.
q: 这是什么问题,layer-wise LR decay 如何缓解?
q_en: What is this, and how does layer-wise LR decay mitigate it?
why: 这是灾难性遗忘:lr 太大把预训练学到的通用表示迅速覆盖掉。分层 lr 衰减给靠近输入的通用层很小的 lr(几乎不动)、靠近输出的任务层较大的 lr,既保住底层通用知识又让上层适应新任务。
why_en: It's catastrophic forgetting from a too-high LR; layer-wise LR decay gives tiny LRs to general early layers and larger LRs to task-specific late layers.
options: 是欠拟合,把学习率再调大一点让它更快收敛
灾难性遗忘;分层 lr 保住浅层通用知识,深层大步适应
是数据泄漏,和学习率的大小完全没有关系
是梯度消失,给深层加残差连接或换个更平滑的激活函数就能修复
options_en: It is underfitting; raise the learning rate further so it converges faster.
Catastrophic forgetting; layer-wise LR protects the general early layers while late layers adapt fast.
It is data leakage, entirely unrelated to the learning rate.
It is vanishing gradients; adding residual connections deeper or swapping in a smoother activation would fix it.
optionExplanations: 调更大 lr 只会加剧遗忘,方向完全反了。
对;分层 lr 让通用层小步、任务层大步,是防灾难性遗忘的标准手段。
遗忘是学习率过大覆盖预训练知识,与数据泄漏无关。
梯度消失是深层训练难题,和"通用能力被覆盖"是两回事。
optionExplanations_en: Raising LR worsens forgetting, exactly the wrong direction.
Correct — layer-wise LR moves general layers slowly and task layers faster, the standard guard against catastrophic forgetting.
Forgetting is a too-high LR overwriting pretrained knowledge, unrelated to data leakage.
Vanishing gradients is a deep-training issue, different from general ability being overwritten.

scenario: 要为一个大模型维护 10 个微调变体,全量微调时每个变体都要存一份完整的梯度/优化器状态副本。
scenario_en: Maintaining 10 fine-tuned variants of a large model, full fine-tuning stores a full gradient/optimizer-state copy per variant.
q: 全量微调在多变体/多租户服务下的核心痛点是什么?
q_en: What is full fine-tuning's core pain in multi-variant / multi-tenant serving?
why: 每个任务都存一整份权重+梯度/优化器副本,10 个变体=10 份完整模型压在显存/存储里,多租户服务成本高到不可行。PEFT 正是为此:冻结共享底座,每任务只存少量新增参数。
why_en: Each task keeps a full weight-plus-optimizer copy, so 10 variants means 10 full models in memory — too costly for multi-tenant serving, which PEFT fixes.
options: 每个变体存一整份完整副本,10 份压满显存/存储
全量微调的准确率一定低于 PEFT,和存储开销无关
全量微调无法在 GPU 上训练,只能退回 CPU 慢跑
变体越多推理反而越快,根本不构成问题
options_en: Each variant stores a full copy — ten of them saturate GPU memory and storage.
Full fine-tuning always scores below PEFT on accuracy, unrelated to storage.
Full fine-tuning cannot train on GPU and must fall back to slow CPU.
More variants actually make inference faster, so it is not a problem.
optionExplanations: 对;痛点是存储/显存爆炸——N 个任务 N 份完整模型,多租户服务养不起,这是 PEFT 的动机。
全量微调准确率通常不低于 PEFT,痛点在存储成本不在准确率。
全量微调完全能在 GPU 上训,这与事实不符。
变体多不会让推理更快,反而增加维护和存储负担。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the pain is storage/memory blowup (N tasks, N full models) that multi-tenant serving can't afford, the motivation for PEFT.
Full fine-tuning usually isn't less accurate than PEFT; the pain is storage cost, not accuracy.
Full fine-tuning trains fine on GPU; this is false.
More variants don't speed inference; they add maintenance and storage burden.

scenario: 面试官问 LoRA 具体怎么用很少的参数逼近全量微调。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks how LoRA approximates full fine-tuning with very few parameters.
q: LoRA 的低秩分解是怎么做的?
q_en: How does LoRA's low-rank decomposition work?
why: LoRA 把权重更新 ΔW 分解成两个小矩阵 A×B:A∈R^{d×r}、B∈R^{r×d},秩 r≪d。前向时用冻结的 W 输出加上这条低秩旁路 A×B。只训 A、B,可训练参数从十亿级降到百万级,精度接近全量微调。
why_en: LoRA factorizes the weight update ΔW into two small matrices A×B with rank r much less than d, training only A and B as a low-rank bypass alongside frozen W.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  X["输入"] --> W["冻结 W"]
  X --> A["A (d×r)"] --> B["B (r×d)"]
  W --> S["相加"]
  B --> S
  S --> O["输出"]
options: 把整个 W 重新训练一遍,换个名字改叫 LoRA 而已
把 ΔW 分解成两个小矩阵 A×B(r≪d),只训 A、B
随机丢弃一半权重使其归零来减参,靠稀疏化省显存
把 W 量化成 8-bit 低精度来省下参数量
options_en: Retrain the whole W from scratch and just relabel it LoRA.
Factorize ΔW into two small matrices A×B with rank r far below d, training only A and B.
Randomly zero out half the weights to cut params, relying on sparsity to save memory.
Quantize W down to 8-bit low precision to save parameters.
optionExplanations: LoRA 恰恰不重训整个 W,W 冻结,只训低秩旁路,这说反了。
对;低秩分解 A×B 把可训练参数压到百万级,前向叠加旁路,是 LoRA 的核心。
随机丢权重是剪枝/稀疏化,不是 LoRA 的低秩更新机制。
量化是降精度省存储,和 LoRA 的低秩参数高效微调是两回事。
optionExplanations_en: LoRA specifically doesn't retrain W; W is frozen and only the low-rank bypass trains — this is reversed.
Correct — low-rank A×B compresses trainable params to millions, with the bypass added in the forward pass, LoRA's core.
Randomly dropping weights is pruning/sparsity, not LoRA's low-rank update.
Quantization lowers precision to save storage, different from LoRA's low-rank parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把权重更新分解为两个低秩小矩阵 A×B、只训它们的 PEFT 方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) factorizes the weight update into two low-rank matrices A×B and trains only those.

termDefinitions.meaning: 低秩旁路的中间维度,r≪d 使新增参数极少(如 r=16)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Rank r is the bottleneck dimension of the low-rank bypass; r much less than d keeps added params tiny (e.g. r=16).

scenario: 一个数十亿参数的大模型,用 LoRA 在 r=16 下微调。
scenario_en: A multi-billion-parameter model is fine-tuned with LoRA at r=16.
q: r=16 的 LoRA 在参数量和精度上意味着什么?
q_en: What does LoRA at r=16 mean for parameters and accuracy?
why: 低秩 r=16 让每个被适配的权重矩阵只新增 r×(d行+d列) 量级的参数,总量从数十亿级(全量)降到百万级 LoRA 参数,却能达到接近全量微调的精度。适配器体积小(几 MB),可在注册表里存上百个共享一个底座。
why_en: At r=16, LoRA adds only millions of parameters versus billions for full fine-tuning while reaching near full-FT accuracy, and adapters are a few MB each.
options: 参数量和全量微调一样多,精度也完全一样
可训练参数从数十亿降到百万级,精度接近全量
参数比全量微调更多,精度反而更低,得不偿失
r=16 意味着整个模型总共只有 16 个参数
options_en: Same parameter count as full fine-tuning, and identical accuracy.
Trainable params drop from billions to millions, with accuracy near full fine-tuning.
More params than full fine-tuning yet lower accuracy — a bad trade.
r=16 means the whole model has only sixteen parameters.
optionExplanations: LoRA 可训练参数远少于全量微调,不是一样多。
对;百万级参数换来接近全量的精度、几 MB 适配器,是 LoRA 高效的量级证据。
LoRA 参数更少而非更多,精度接近全量,不是得不偿失。
r 是低秩旁路的秩,不是总参数数,模型仍有数十亿参数。
optionExplanations_en: LoRA's trainable params are far fewer than full fine-tuning, not equal.
Correct — millions of params for near-full accuracy and few-MB adapters is the quantitative evidence of LoRA's efficiency.
LoRA has fewer params, not more, at near-full accuracy — not a bad trade.
r is the low-rank bypass's rank, not total parameter count; the model still has billions of params.

scenario: 关心 LoRA 上线后会不会给推理加延迟,以及能否一个底座服务多任务。
scenario_en: You worry whether LoRA adds inference latency and whether one base can serve many tasks.
q: LoRA 的两种服务方式各是什么?
q_en: What are LoRA's two serving options?
why: 两种:①推理前把旁路合并进权重 W'=W+AB,之后前向和原模型完全一样,零额外延迟;②动态换适配器,一个冻结底座按请求挂不同 LoRA,服务多任务。适配器几 MB,可在注册表里存上百个配一个底座。
why_en: Either merge at inference W'=W+AB for zero added latency, or dynamically swap adapters so one frozen base serves many tasks.
options: 只能每个任务部署一份完整模型,和全量微调一样重
合并 W'=W+AB 零延迟,或动态换适配器服务多任务
LoRA 推理必然比原模型慢很多,而且这个延迟无法消除
单个适配器动辄就有几 GB,注册表里根本放不下几个
options_en: You must deploy a full model per task, as heavy as full fine-tuning.
Merge W'=W+AB for zero added latency, or hot-swap adapters so one base serves many tasks.
LoRA inference is inevitably far slower than the base, and this latency cannot be eliminated.
A single adapter can easily run several GB, so a registry can barely hold a few.
optionExplanations: LoRA 共享一个底座、只挂小适配器,不需要每任务一份完整模型。
对;合并后零延迟、或动态换适配器多任务共享底座,正是 LoRA 服务的两种玩法。
合并 AB 进 W 后前向与原模型无异,零额外延迟,不是必然更慢。
适配器只有几 MB,注册表能存上百个配一个底座。
optionExplanations_en: LoRA shares one base with small adapters, needing no full model per task.
Correct — merge for zero latency or dynamically swap adapters over a shared base, LoRA's two serving modes.
After merging AB into W the forward pass matches the base with zero added latency, not inevitably slower.
Adapters are only a few MB, so a registry holds hundreds atop one base.

termDefinitions.meaning: LoRA 为某任务训练出的低秩权重增量(A、B),体积仅几 MB。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An adapter is LoRA's low-rank weight delta (A, B) trained for a task, only a few MB.

termDefinitions.meaning: 推理前把 AB 加回 W 得到 W'=W+AB,之后前向零额外开销。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Merging adds AB back into W to get W'=W+AB before inference, so the forward pass has zero extra cost.

diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["合并模式"] --> W1["W'=W+AB"] --> Z["零额外延迟"]
  S["动态换模式"] --> B["冻结底座"] --> R["按请求挂 LoRA"] --> T["多任务共享"]

scenario: 要为一个 7B LLM 维护 10 个针对不同客户/任务的微调变体,还得多租户同机服务,显存吃紧。
scenario_en: Maintaining 10 fine-tuned variants of a 7B LLM for different customers/tasks, served multi-tenant on one machine with tight memory.
q: 这种多变体多租户场景,LoRA 的关键优势是什么?
q_en: In this multi-variant multi-tenant setting, what's LoRA's key advantage?
why: 共享一个 7B 底座,每个任务只存一个几 MB 的轻量适配器,而不是 10 份完整 7B 副本。显存里驻留一个底座+按需挂适配器,多租户服务成本骤降;合并后还零额外延迟。
why_en: Share one 7B base and store only a lightweight few-MB adapter per task instead of ten full copies, slashing multi-tenant serving cost.
options: 每个变体都全量微调并各存一份 7B 副本,准确率最高
共享一个 7B 底座,每任务只存几 MB 适配器
把 10 个任务合并成一个模型,放弃任务间的区分
给每个租户单独一台机器各跑一份完整 7B
options_en: Full fine-tune each variant and keep a 7B copy each, since accuracy is highest.
Share one 7B base and store only a few-MB adapter per task.
Merge the ten tasks into one model and give up distinguishing them.
Give every tenant a dedicated machine running its own full 7B.
whenOtherWins: 若只有单一任务、无需多变体,且追求极致精度,直接全量微调一个模型反而更简单,不必引入适配器管理。
optionExplanations: 10 份完整 7B 副本显存/存储爆炸,多租户同机根本放不下。
对;一个底座+多个几 MB 适配器,是 LoRA 在多变体多租户下省显存的核心优势。
合并任务会丢掉各客户/任务的差异化,不满足需求。
每租户一台机成本极高,LoRA 的意义正是一机多租户共享底座。
optionExplanations_en: Ten full 7B copies blow up memory/storage and can't fit multi-tenant on one machine.
Correct — one base plus many few-MB adapters is LoRA's core advantage for saving memory under multi-variant multi-tenant serving.
Merging tasks loses per-customer differentiation and fails the requirement.
A machine per tenant is very costly; LoRA's point is one machine serving many tenants over a shared base.

scenario: 面试官让你列举 PEFT 家族里的具体方法。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to list concrete methods in the PEFT family.
q: 以下哪些是 PEFT(参数高效微调)方法?(多选)
q_en: Which are PEFT (parameter-efficient fine-tuning) methods? (multiple)
why: PEFT 都冻结大部分权重、只训少量新增参数:LoRA(低秩增量)、prefix tuning(输入前拼可学 token)、adapter layers(层间瓶颈模块)。全量微调更新所有权重,不属于 PEFT。
why_en: PEFT methods freeze most weights and train a small added set: LoRA, prefix tuning, and adapter layers; full fine-tuning is not PEFT.
options: LoRA(低秩权重增量,可零延迟合并)
prefix tuning(在输入前拼可学习的 token embedding)
adapter layers(在 transformer 层间插瓶颈模块)
全量微调(更新模型所有权重)
options_en: LoRA (low-rank weight delta, zero-latency merge).
Prefix tuning (prepend learnable token embeddings to the input).
Adapter layers (insert bottleneck modules between transformer layers).
Full fine-tuning (update all model weights).
optionExplanations: 对;LoRA 是最主流的 PEFT,低秩增量+零延迟合并。
对;prefix tuning 只学一段前缀 embedding,冻结主体,是 PEFT。
对;adapter layers 在层间插小瓶颈模块,只训它,是经典 PEFT。
错;全量微调更新所有权重,恰恰是 PEFT 要避免的重成本做法。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — LoRA is the dominant PEFT method, low-rank delta with zero-latency merge.
Correct — prefix tuning learns only a prefix embedding with the body frozen, a PEFT method.
Correct — adapter layers insert small bottleneck modules between layers and train only those, classic PEFT.
Wrong — full fine-tuning updates all weights, the heavy cost PEFT avoids.

termDefinitions.meaning: 冻结模型,只学习一段拼在输入前的可训练 token embedding。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Prefix tuning freezes the model and learns only a trainable token-embedding prefix prepended to the input.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 transformer 层之间插入的小瓶颈模块,微调时只训它们。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Adapter layers are small bottleneck modules inserted between transformer layers, the only part fine-tuned.

scenario: 想把一个大 teacher 模型的能力搬到一个小 student 上,让 student 学得比只看硬标签更多。
scenario_en: You want to move a large teacher's ability into a small student that learns more than from hard labels alone.
q: 知识蒸馏里 student 从 teacher 学的关键是什么?
q_en: In knowledge distillation, what is the key thing the student learns from the teacher?
why: student 学 teacher 的软概率输出,而不只是 one-hot 硬标签。软概率编码了类间关系("dark knowledge",如"7"比起"0"更像"1"),给出比硬标签丰富得多的监督信号,让小模型学到大模型的判别结构。
why_en: The student learns the teacher's soft probability outputs, not just one-hot hard labels, which encode inter-class relationships (dark knowledge).
options: 只学 one-hot 硬标签,和普通监督训练完全一样
学 teacher 的软概率输出,里面编码了类间关系
直接把 teacher 的权重复制到 student 里面
让 student 随机初始化后就不再训练它
options_en: Only the one-hot hard labels, exactly like ordinary supervised training.
The teacher soft probability outputs, which encode inter-class relationships.
Copy the teacher weights straight into the student.
Randomly initialize the student and then never train it.
optionExplanations: 只学硬标签就没蒸馏了,软概率里的类间信息才是蒸馏的价值。
对;软概率的 dark knowledge 提供硬标签没有的类间相似度,让小模型学得更好。
student 结构比 teacher 小,权重维度不匹配,无法直接复制。
不训练学不到任何东西,蒸馏需要用 teacher 输出做监督。
optionExplanations_en: Only hard labels isn't distillation; the inter-class info in soft probabilities is distillation's value.
Correct — soft-probability dark knowledge provides inter-class similarity absent from hard labels, helping the small model learn better.
The student is smaller with mismatched weight dimensions, so weights can't be copied directly.
Without training it learns nothing; distillation needs the teacher's outputs as supervision.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练小 student 模仿大 teacher 的软输出,把能力迁移到更小模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Knowledge distillation trains a small student to mimic a large teacher's soft outputs, transferring ability into a smaller model.

termDefinitions.meaning: 软概率里蕴含的类间相似关系(如"7"更像"1"而非"0")。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dark knowledge is the inter-class similarity in soft probabilities (a '7' looks more like a '1' than a '0').

scenario: teacher 的 softmax 输出几乎是 one-hot(某类接近 1),非目标类的概率几乎为 0,student 学不到类间关系。
scenario_en: The teacher's softmax is nearly one-hot (one class near 1), non-target class probabilities near 0, so the student can't learn inter-class relations.
q: 温度缩放(T>1)在蒸馏里起什么作用?
q_en: What does temperature scaling (T>1) do in distillation?
why: 把 teacher 的 logits 除以温度 T>1 再过 softmax,分布被软化,非目标类的相对概率被放大、显现出来。这样 student 才能学到"哪些非目标类更接近"的暗知识,而不是几乎 one-hot 的贫瘠信号。
why_en: Dividing teacher logits by T>1 before softmax softens the distribution, revealing non-target class probabilities so the student can learn dark knowledge.
options: T>1 让分布更尖锐,更接近 one-hot
T>1 软化分布,放大非目标类概率
T 就是学习率,调得越大训练收敛越快
T>1 会删掉非目标类,只保留最高的那类
options_en: T>1 sharpens the distribution, pushing it closer to one-hot.
T>1 softens the distribution and amplifies non-target class probabilities.
T is just the learning rate; larger values converge faster.
T>1 deletes the non-target classes and keeps only the top one.
optionExplanations: T>1 是软化不是锐化,更尖锐反而抹掉了要学的类间信息。
对;除以 T>1 让软分布显现非目标类相对概率,student 才能吸收暗知识。
T 是温度不是学习率,它调分布软硬,与步长无关。
软化是放大非目标类而非删除它们,恰恰相反。
optionExplanations_en: T>1 softens, not sharpens; sharper would erase the inter-class info to be learned.
Correct — dividing by T>1 surfaces non-target relative probabilities so the student absorbs dark knowledge.
T is temperature, not learning rate; it tunes distribution softness, unrelated to step size.
Softening amplifies non-target classes rather than deleting them — the opposite.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 logits 除以温度 T 再 softmax,T>1 使分布更平滑、显现非目标类概率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Temperature scaling divides logits by T before softmax; T>1 smooths the distribution and reveals non-target class probabilities.

scenario: 回忆蒸馏的损失如何同时用硬标签和 teacher 软输出。
scenario_en: Recall how the distillation loss combines hard labels and the teacher's soft outputs.
q: 补全知识蒸馏的损失:
q_en: Fill in the knowledge-distillation loss:
text: L = (1−α)·{{L_CE}} + α·{{T²}}·L_KL:前项对硬标签的交叉熵,后项是 teacher/student 软输出的 {{KL}} 散度。
text_en: L = (1−α)·{{L_CE}} + α·{{T²}}·L_KL: the first term is cross-entropy on hard labels, the second is the {{KL}} divergence between teacher/student soft outputs.
why: 两项加权:硬标签交叉熵保底正确性,teacher/student 软输出的 KL 散度传暗知识;乘 T² 补偿软化后梯度被缩小的量级。α 平衡两者。
why_en: It weights hard-label cross-entropy against the teacher-student soft-output KL divergence, scaling the KL term by T-squared.

scenario: 实时排序想用更小更快的 BERT,DistilBERT 保留约 97% BERT 准确率、参数少约 40%。
scenario_en: For real-time ranking you want a smaller, faster BERT; DistilBERT keeps ~97% of BERT's accuracy with ~40% fewer parameters.
q: DistilBERT 这组数字说明蒸馏的什么价值?
q_en: What does DistilBERT's numbers show about distillation's value?
why: 约 97% 准确率、少约 40% 参数、推理更快——蒸馏用很小的准确率代价换来显著更小更快的模型,足以放进实时排序的延迟预算。前提是 student 容量够大能吸收 teacher,且要先跑 teacher 全量推理产软标签。
why_en: DistilBERT keeps ~97% accuracy with ~40% fewer params and faster inference, trading tiny accuracy for a much smaller, real-time-viable model.
options: 说明蒸馏一定无损,准确率完全不会下降
小准确率代价换显著更小更快,够进实时预算
说明 student 越小反而越准,应该继续往下压
说明蒸馏不需要 teacher,student 自己就能学好
options_en: It shows distillation is lossless, with no accuracy drop at all.
A tiny accuracy cost buys a much smaller, faster model that fits the real-time budget.
It shows a smaller student is more accurate, so keep compressing.
It shows distillation needs no teacher; the student learns fine alone.
optionExplanations: 97% 意味着掉了约 3 个点,不是无损,蒸馏是有代价的权衡。
对;小代价换大瘦身+提速,正是蒸馏让大模型能落进实时预算的价值。
越压越准不成立,student 太小容量不足反而掉更多,存在下限。
蒸馏必须有 teacher 提供软标签,student 单独学不到暗知识。
optionExplanations_en: 97% means about 3 points lost, not lossless; distillation is a costed trade-off.
Correct — a small cost for big shrink-and-speedup is exactly how distillation makes big models fit real-time budgets.
Smaller isn't more accurate; too small a student underfits and loses more, with a floor.
Distillation needs a teacher for soft labels; the student can't learn dark knowledge alone.

termDefinitions.meaning: BERT 的蒸馏版,约 97% 准确率、参数少约 40%、推理更快。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DistilBERT is a distilled BERT keeping ~97% accuracy with ~40% fewer parameters and faster inference.

scenario: 要给蒸馏预算算力,团队以为蒸馏很便宜。
scenario_en: Budgeting compute for distillation, the team assumes it's cheap.
q: 蒸馏有哪笔容易被忽视的成本,还有什么前提?
q_en: What overlooked cost and prerequisite does distillation have?
why: 得让 teacher 对整个训练集跑一遍推理来产软标签,这是一次性但可观的算力,必须提前预算。另一个前提:student 容量要足够大,才装得下 teacher 的知识,太小会欠拟合、掉点更多。
why_en: You must run teacher inference over the full training set to produce soft labels — a one-time but significant compute — and the student must be large enough to absorb the teacher.
options: 蒸馏几乎零成本,直接拿现成的软标签训练就行了
teacher 全训练集跑一遍推理产软标签,student 要够大
蒸馏根本不需要训练集,只要拿到 teacher 的模型权重文件即可
student 容量越小越好,大小根本不是要考虑的问题
options_en: Distillation is nearly free — just train on ready-made soft labels.
The teacher runs inference over the whole training set for soft labels, and the student must be big enough.
Distillation needs no training set at all, only the teacher's model weight files.
A smaller student is always better; its capacity is not a concern at all.
optionExplanations: 软标签要现产:teacher 得对全训练集推理一遍,不是零成本。
对;一次性 teacher 全量推理是真实算力开销,加上 student 容量下限,是蒸馏两个易忽视点。
产软标签正需要训练集输入,只有权重没有数据蒸不了。
student 太小容量不足会欠拟合掉更多点,容量是硬约束。
optionExplanations_en: Soft labels must be generated: the teacher runs over the full training set — not free.
Correct — one-time full teacher inference is real compute, plus a student capacity floor, distillation's two overlooked points.
Producing soft labels needs the training-set inputs; weights without data can't distill.
Too small a student underfits and loses more; capacity is a hard constraint.

scenario: 要剪枝一个模型让它在标准 GPU/CPU 上真的变快,而不只是权重矩阵里多了很多 0。
scenario_en: You want pruning that actually speeds the model on standard GPU/CPU, not just more zeros in the weight matrix.
q: 结构化剪枝和非结构化剪枝的关键区别是什么?
q_en: What's the key difference between structured and unstructured pruning?
why: 结构化剪枝整块移除组件(卷积滤波器、注意力头、整层),产出真正更小的稠密网络,在标准硬件上直接加速;非结构化剪枝把单个权重置零,得到稀疏矩阵,要专门的稀疏计算库才可能加速,普通硬件上未必快。
why_en: Structured pruning removes whole components for a genuinely smaller dense model that speeds up on standard hardware, while unstructured zeros individual weights needing sparse libraries.
options: 结构化是置零单个权重、非结构化是删整层,正好相反
结构化删整块组件→稠密变小;非结构化置零单权重→稀疏
两者其实完全一样,都能在标准硬件上直接加速
两者都只是把权重数值变小一点,不改变结构
options_en: Structured zeros individual weights and unstructured deletes whole layers — exactly reversed.
Structured removes whole components giving a smaller dense model; unstructured zeros single weights giving sparsity.
They are actually identical and both speed things up on standard hardware.
Both merely shrink weight values a little without changing structure.
optionExplanations: 粒度说反了:结构化删整块组件,非结构化才是置零单个权重。
对;结构化产稠密小网络在标准硬件直接快,非结构化稀疏要专用库,这是能否真加速的分水岭。
两者硬件加速表现不同:稠密标准硬件就快,稀疏不装库未必快。
结构化会真正改变架构(移除整块),不是只把权重变小。
optionExplanations_en: Granularity reversed: structured removes whole components; unstructured zeros individual weights.
Correct — structured yields a dense small net fast on standard hardware while unstructured is sparse needing special libraries, the divide on real speedup.
Their hardware speedup differs: dense is fast on standard hardware, sparse may not be without libraries.
Structured genuinely changes the architecture by removing whole blocks, not just shrinking weights.

termDefinitions.meaning: 整块移除滤波器/注意力头/层,产出更小的稠密网络,标准硬件即加速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Structured pruning removes whole filters/heads/layers, yielding a smaller dense network that speeds up on standard hardware.

termDefinitions.term: unstructured pruning / 非结构化剪枝
termDefinitions.meaning: 把单个权重置零得到稀疏矩阵,需稀疏计算库才可能加速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Unstructured pruning zeros individual weights into a sparse matrix, needing sparse-computation libraries to speed up.

tradeoff: 标准硬件上的真实加速 vs 剪枝粒度的灵活性

scenario: 要对一个训好的模型做结构化剪枝,同时把准确率损失控制在 <2%。
scenario_en: You structured-prune a trained model while keeping accuracy loss under 2%.
q: 把结构化剪枝的工作流排成正确顺序:
q_en: Order the structured-pruning workflow correctly:
steps: 先训练出一个完整的高准确率模型
微调剪枝后的网络,恢复被剪掉带来的准确率损失
按重要性打分(L1 范数/Taylor 展开)对组件排序
移除得分最低的组件(滤波器/头/层)
why: 先训好完整模型→按 L1 范数/Taylor 展开给组件打重要性分→移除最不重要的组件→再微调恢复精度。这套"训练→剪枝→微调"能砍 FLOPs 30–70% 而准确率损失 <2%。
why_en: Train a full model, score components by L1 norm/Taylor, remove the lowest, then fine-tune to recover accuracy — cutting FLOPs 30-70% with under 2% loss.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  T["训练完整模型"] --> S["打分排序"]
  S --> R["移除最低分组件"]
  R --> F["微调恢复"]

termDefinitions.term: L1 norm / Taylor expansion 打分
termDefinitions.meaning: 用权重 L1 范数或 Taylor 展开估计每个组件对损失的重要性,以决定剪谁。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scoring by L1 norm or Taylor expansion estimates each component's importance to the loss, deciding what to prune.

scenario: 结构化剪枝配合剪后微调,常能砍掉 30–70% 的 FLOPs 而准确率损失 <2%。
scenario_en: Structured pruning with post-prune fine-tuning often cuts 30-70% of FLOPs at under 2% accuracy loss.
q: 这组数字对边缘部署意味着什么?
q_en: What do these numbers mean for edge deployment?
why: FLOPs 砍 30–70% 直接换来延迟/能耗大幅下降,而 <2% 准确率损失通常可接受——对 <50MB/<10ms 的边缘预算,结构化剪枝往往是性价比很高的一步。这是经验量级,依模型/任务而变,不是保证。
why_en: Cutting 30-70% FLOPs sharply lowers latency/energy at under 2% accuracy loss, making structured pruning a high-value step for tight edge budgets.
options: 说明剪枝一定完全无损,可以一路剪到接近 0 也完全不掉点
FLOPs 砍 30–70%,<2% 损失换低延迟低能耗
说明剪枝反而会让模型变得更大、推理更慢
30–70% 指的是剪枝带来的准确率提升幅度
options_en: It shows pruning is completely lossless, so you can prune down to near zero without any drop at all.
Cutting 30-70% of FLOPs trades under 2% accuracy for low latency and energy.
It shows pruning actually makes the model bigger and inference slower.
The 30-70% refers to the accuracy gain that pruning brings.
optionExplanations: 有 <2% 损失说明不是无损,剪过头会崩,不能剪到 0。
对;把 FLOPs 削减翻译成延迟/能耗下降+可接受的精度损失,是边缘部署该讲的设计含义。
剪枝是让模型更小更快,方向说反了。
30–70% 是 FLOPs 削减幅度,不是准确率提升;准确率是略降 <2%。
optionExplanations_en: The under-2% loss shows it isn't lossless; over-pruning collapses accuracy, so not to zero.
Correct — translating FLOP cuts into latency/energy drop at acceptable accuracy loss is the edge-deployment implication to state.
Pruning makes the model smaller and faster — the direction is reversed.
30-70% is the FLOP reduction, not accuracy gain; accuracy slightly drops under 2%.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次前向的浮点运算量,衡量计算成本,减少它直接降延迟/能耗。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FLOPs (Floating-Point Operations) count a forward pass's arithmetic, a compute-cost measure whose reduction lowers latency/energy.

scenario: 便宜的压缩手段(量化/剪枝/蒸馏)都试过仍不达预算,或要为某类硬件长期打造最优架构。
scenario_en: Cheaper compression (quantization/pruning/distillation) is exhausted or you must craft an optimal architecture for a hardware class long-term.
q: 什么时候才轮到 NAS,怎么定位它?
q_en: When is NAS warranted, and how do you position it?
why: NAS 是最后手段:能自动搜出最优高效架构(EfficientNet 就出自此),但历史上要上千 GPU 小时。one-shot/权重共享(DARTS、OFA)可把成本降几个数量级。
why_en: Position NAS as the last resort: best results but historically thousands of GPU-hours, used only after cheaper techniques are exhausted.
options: 一上来就用 NAS,反正它出来的效果最好
把 NAS 当最后手段:效果最好但也最贵
NAS 是最便宜的手段,应该第一个拿来试
NAS 和量化成本差不多,先后顺序无所谓
options_en: Reach for NAS right away, since it gives the best results anyway.
Treat NAS as the last resort: best results but also the priciest.
NAS is the cheapest technique and should be tried first.
NAS costs about the same as quantization, so order does not matter.
whenOtherWins: 当量化/剪枝/蒸馏这些便宜手段就能满足预算时,根本不该动 NAS,先用它们省时省钱。
optionExplanations: 一上来就 NAS 是烧钱,多数预算便宜手段就能满足,不必付最贵代价。
对;NAS 效果最好但最贵,定位为最后手段、便宜手段用尽再上,是成本理性的做法。
NAS 恰恰最贵,不是最便宜,顺序上应最后而非最先。
NAS 比量化贵几个数量级,成本顺序很重要,不能忽略。
optionExplanations_en: Leading with NAS burns money; most budgets are met by cheaper techniques, so don't pay the costliest first.
Correct — NAS gives the best results but is costliest, positioned as last resort after cheaper techniques, the cost-rational move.
NAS is the costliest, not cheapest, so it goes last not first.
NAS is orders of magnitude costlier than quantization, so cost order matters and can't be ignored.

termDefinitions.meaning: one-shot/权重共享的 NAS 方法,把搜索成本从上千 GPU 小时降几个数量级。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DARTS and OFA (once-for-all) are one-shot/weight-sharing NAS methods cutting search cost by orders of magnitude.

tradeoff: 架构质量的上限 vs 搜索要烧的 GPU 小时

scenario: 300M ViT 要压进 <50MB/<10ms,团队问第一个该动的压缩手段是哪个。
scenario_en: The 300M ViT must fit <50MB/<10ms; the team asks which compression to try first.
q: 成本有序的压缩流水线里第一步该做什么?
q_en: What's the first step in the cost-ordered compression pipeline?
why: 先做量化——最便宜:把权重/激活从 FP32 降到 INT8 等低精度,直接减体积和加速,改动小、常常一步就大幅接近预算。达标就停,不够再依次上剪枝、蒸馏、NAS。
why_en: Do quantization first — the cheapest step: lower precision (e.g. FP32 to INT8) shrinks size and speeds inference with minimal change, escalating only if needed.
options: 先做最贵的 NAS,从头搜一个高效架构出来
先做量化:最便宜,降精度直接减体积并加速
先做蒸馏,专门训一个更小的 student 模型
先做非结构化剪枝,把一半权重直接置零
options_en: Start with the costliest NAS and search an efficient architecture from scratch.
Quantize first — cheapest: lower precision shrinks size and speeds it up.
Distill first and train a dedicated smaller student model.
Prune unstructured first, zeroing out half the weights.
whenOtherWins: 若量化后仍超预算,再按成本顺序叠加剪枝、蒸馏,最后才考虑 NAS。
optionExplanations: NAS 最贵,放第一步违背成本有序原则,多数情况用不着。
对;量化最便宜、改动最小,先试它、达标即停,是成本有序流水线的起点。
蒸馏比量化贵(要跑 teacher 全量推理),不该排在量化之前。
非结构化剪枝产稀疏矩阵,标准硬件未必加速,也不是最便宜的第一步。
optionExplanations_en: NAS is costliest; putting it first violates cost ordering and is usually unnecessary.
Correct — quantization is cheapest with minimal change, so try it first and stop if met, the pipeline's starting point.
Distillation is costlier than quantization (needs full teacher inference), so it shouldn't precede quantization.
Unstructured pruning yields a sparse matrix that may not speed up standard hardware, and isn't the cheapest first step.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把权重/激活从高精度(FP32)降到低精度(INT8)以减体积、加速,是最便宜的压缩手段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Quantization lowers weights/activations from high precision (FP32) to low (INT8) to shrink size and speed up, the cheapest compression.

tradeoff: 压缩收益 vs 每一级手段的工程与算力成本
